answer: Every identity posts a refundable 280 POA bond locked 110 days behind one device key, and files one atlas page mapping its whole work history. The page is sealed with a basalt foundation key that cannot be copied or shared, so one person cannot run two pages. Three auditors drawn by lot tend the orchard of filed pages each month, re-running one listed job live to confirm it happened. A forged page or shared key burns the whole bond and bars the identity for a year.
